Android diagnoser
Sources: dumpsys appops, dumpsys package, dumpsys activity, dumpsys jobscheduler, dumpsys power, dumpsys location, dumpsys sensorservice, dumpsys clipboard, dumpsys netstats, /proc/net/tcp, /proc/net/udp, logcat DNS

Network sockets belong to a Linux uid. On Android that uid is usually one app.
Transmission shown here is destination, size, and DNS name. HTTPS message bodies stay encrypted.
Tracker SDK rows are components shipped inside the app and the kind of data that SDK is built to collect.

## What each app is doing, tracking, and transmitting
No app showed live activity, sensitive access, tracker components, or network traffic in this snapshot.

## Declared sensitive access with no live evidence in this snapshot
None.
